questions.question: Command-based verification of settings.ini is impossible while sandbox.bash is on (no shell at all, including read-only `od`). How do you want to close out the outstanding verification step?

options.label: I'll disable sandbox.bash, then you rerun it
options.description: Settings → Sandbox, or `[sandbox] bash = "off"` in config.toml. Tell me when done and I'll run `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` and paste the exact bytes.

options.label: Accept the file-content check as the verification
options.description: I re-read settings.ini and confirmed retries=3 / timeout=30 on adjacent lines inside [client]; no command-level check is possible here.

options.label: You run the command and paste the output
options.description: Keep the sandbox on; you execute `od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6` locally and I'll record the result.
